Shipping Policy

At Jersey Orbit, we strive to deliver your order as quickly and safely as possible.

1. Delivery Timelines We partner with reliable courier services to ensure timely delivery across India.

  • Kerala: Orders are typically delivered within 2 - 3 business days.

  • Rest of India: Orders are typically delivered within 5 - 10 business days.

2. Shipping Charges We offer affordable shipping rates based on your location:

  • Kerala: Flat rate of ₹59.

  • Outside Kerala (Rest of India): Flat rate of ₹99.

3. Order Processing All orders are processed and dispatched within 24 hours of placement (excluding Sundays and public holidays). You will receive a confirmation once your order is packed and ready to ship.

4. Tracking Your Order Once your jersey is shipped, we will share a tracking ID via WhatsApp or Email. You can use this ID to track the real-time status of your package.

5. Contact Us For any shipping-related queries, please contact our support team:

  • WhatsApp: +91 89434 78770

  • Email: jerseyorbit@gmail.com
